headlines.text: It was 2019 when Billy Gunn stepped through the curtain for the first time in a Battle Royal match against Adam Page vs. MJF vs. Chuck Taylor vs. Jimmy Havoc vs. Joey Janela vs. Jungle Boy vs. Kip Sabian vs. Marko Stunt vs. Orange Cassidy vs. Pentagon Jr. vs. Sonny Kiss, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.48.

Back on this day in 2024, Kyle Fletcher reached a genuine milestone: their 50th match in AEW, facing Fletcher & Takeshita vs. Kyle Fletcher vs. Konosuke Takeshita vs. Brian Cage vs. Lance Archer vs. Mark Davis vs. Powerhouse Hobbs vs. Ricochet vs. Will Ospreay, kicking off the show on Dynamite, rated 6.80.
That Wednesday in 2019, Jon Moxley vs. Darby Allin met for the very first time, topping the bill that night on Dynamite, rated 7.72 ? a match that delivered.

secondaries.text: 2019 brought us this moment: Rey Fenix vs. Nick Jackson delivered one of the better matches of the year on Dynamite, rated 8.08.
Rewind to 2024, when Claudio Castagnoli vs. Darby Allin locked horns for the first time on Dynamite, rated 7.60 ? a strong outing.
That Wednesday in 2024, Orange Cassidy vs. Wheeler Yuta closed out Dynamite, rated 5.86 in a hard-fought men's division clash.
